title: ClassPass vs Gym Membership in NZ — Which Saves More Money?
meta_desc: Compare ClassPass prices with gym memberships in NZ, ClassPass vs gym membership
intro: Aucklanders can save up to $30 per week by choosing ClassPass over a dedicated gym membership, but is it the best value for everyone? With ClassPass credits starting at $49 per month for 3 credits, the real cost per class can add up quickly. Let's dive into the numbers to find out which option is best for you.

sections.heading: How ClassPass Works in NZ
sections.body: ClassPass is a subscription-based fitness platform that allows users to attend classes at various studios across NZ. The credits system can be confusing, so it's essential to understand how it works before signing up. For example, a yoga class at Yoga House in Wellington may cost 4-6 credits, while a strength training class at F45 Training in Auckland may cost 3-5 credits.

sections.heading: Dedicated Gym Membership Prices in NZ
Price Comparison: ClassPass vs Gym Membership
Best Use Cases for ClassPass and Gym Membership
sections.body: ClassPass is ideal for those who enjoy variety in their workout routine and want to try different classes at various studios. On the other hand, a dedicated gym membership is best for those who prefer a consistent routine and want to use the gym's facilities regularly. For example, if you're a student at the University of Auckland, a gym membership at the university's recreation centre may be a more affordable option.
